title: DNS over QUIC RFC 9250 0-RTT Replay Protection Verification
verification_method: Focused unit tests for opcode classification, client-side 0-RTT gating, server-side queue behavior, and existing test regression checks.
scope: This verification covers DNS opcode classification, client-side 0-RTT gating, and server-side 0-RTT queue and limit enforcement.
expected_result: All DoQ tests pass, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9250 artifacts including slice 0013, and no whitespace hygiene issues are introduced.
status_summary: The DoQ adapter now classifies DNS opcodes for replayability, gates 0-RTT on the client side, and manages 0-RTT query queues on the server side. All 8 REQs are traced and verified.
